Priya: vote: limerick or chant? react with :one: limerick, :two: chant
Maya: putting :one: down. limerick for the win
OpsBot: Poll results in 30s: limerick 4, chant 2
Leo: ok limerick practice at 2:58 in the lounge. please bring a prop (socks count)
Nina: socks secured. wacky pattern encouraged :socks:
Jon: quick logistics q: where did the extra sticky name tags go? lost mine in a sea of confetti
Chris: I think Facilities saved an extra box in the kitchen cabinet labeled "emergency nametags"

Maya: thanks everyone, best all-hands vibe in ages. see you at the lounge for the great limerick debut :tada:
